categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Wave Cyber Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of membrane materials and related professional supporting equipment. Its main products include reverse osmosis membranes, nanofiltration membranes, membrane element pressure vessels, and composite material pressure tanks. The company also provides water treatment equipment and services, including operation and maintenance services and engineering project services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in high-performance spiral wound separation membranes and related equipment, including patented polymer modification, precise coating, membrane cleaning mechanisms, and composite material pressure vessel design. It has developed advanced production lines integrating membrane casting and coating, and employs slit coating technology for membrane layers. The company also utilizes program-controlled fiber winding and curing technologies for composite pressure tanks, with ISO9001 quality management certification and international certifications such as NSF, ASME, and KTW.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial enterprises in sectors such as municipal water supply, wastewater treatment, seawater desalination, power, metallurgy, chemical, and food and beverage industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales to customers in Europe, America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. The top five customers accounted for approximately 34.74% of annual sales, indicating a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai and Huzhou, Zhejiang Province, and has subsidiaries in the United States and other regions. Its sales cover domestic markets and overseas markets including Europe, America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. The overseas assets accounted for about 2.29% of total assets at year-end.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Wave Cyber operates mainly in the midstream segment of the membrane separation industry, focusing on the manufacturing of membrane materials, membrane elements, and composite pressure vessels. It integrates upstream polymer and raw material processing technologies with downstream water treatment system integration and service provision, positioning itself as a core component supplier in the membrane separation supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, investing heavily in R&D to enhance membrane performance and develop high-value products such as acid-alkali resistant membranes, seawater desalination membranes, and high-flux household membranes. It actively explores new application areas including lithium extraction from ores and batteries, zero-discharge industrial systems, and seawater desalination. The company maintains a robust patent portfolio and participates in national and provincial key technology projects to sustain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of membrane materials, membrane elements, composite pressure tanks, and water treatment equipment. The company also earns income from providing operation and maintenance services, engineering project services, and design services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales (over 70%) complemented by distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international membrane manufacturers such as DuPont Water Solutions (Dow), Koch, Toray, Hydranautics, and SUEZ (GE), as well as domestic competitors like Walton Technology. While it faces challenges in scale, brand recognition, and experience compared to global leaders, it leverages its proprietary technologies and diversified product portfolio to strengthen its market position and expand into specialized membrane applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 375.24 million, a slight decrease of 2.34% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 38.59 million, down 16%. Total assets reached RMB 911.46 million, with net assets of RMB 772.11 million. The company increased R&D investment by 6.37% to RMB 29.14 million, representing 7.77% of revenue. Despite some revenue decline due to production base relocation and order delays, cash flow from operations improved by 17.71%. The company completed a share repurchase of 906,648 shares in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Wave Cyber emphasizes its advanced proprietary membrane technologies, comprehensive product lines covering membranes, membrane elements, and composite pressure vessels, and high-quality manufacturing standards certified by international authorities. Its products offer high flux, salt rejection, durability, and resistance to harsh chemical environments. The company supports domestic supply chain security by reducing reliance on foreign brands and provides customized solutions for diverse industrial and municipal water treatment applications, contributing to environmental sustainability and resource efficiency.
